source_message:
feat(g01): Decision Event Log — append-only PostgreSQL audit trail

ports/audit_port.py (G-16 partial):
  AuditPort ABC — append_event() + query_events() only
  No update_event/delete_event — I-24 enforced at design level

utils/decision_event_log.py:
  DecisionEvent dataclass — immutable, from_aml_result() factory
  PostgresEventLogAdapter — asyncpg, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (idempotent)
    fail-safe: DB errors logged, never propagated to caller
  InMemoryAuditAdapter — for tests/dev, no Postgres required
  get_decision_log() / set_decision_log() — injectable adapter pattern

decision_events.sql (migration):
  CREATE TABLE banxe_compliance.decision_events
  REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE ON decision_events FROM banxe_app_role  ← I-24
  GRANT SELECT, INSERT only
  Indexes: case_id, customer_id, occurred_at, tx_id, decision

banxe_aml_orchestrator.py:
  Import DecisionEvent + get_decision_log
  After every banxe_assess(): append_event (fire-and-forget)
  DB failure never affects compliance decision output

test_decision_event_log.py — 15 tests:
  T-01..T-02  from_aml_result mapping, append returns event_id
  T-03..T-05  query by case_id / customer_id / idempotent
  T-06        I-24: no update/delete methods on port or adapters
  T-07..T-08  PostgresEventLogAdapter fail-safe + mocked insert
  T-09..T-10  get/set_decision_log injection
  T-11        banxe_assess() → append_event called (integration point)
  T-12..T-15  JSON serialisable, ABC abstract, query limit

Tests: 89/89 pass

Closes: GAP-REGISTER G-01 (pending migration deploy)
Invariants: I-24 (append-only audit trail)
Supports: replay_decision.py (G-01 replay via case_id / customer_id query)
